systems.country_label: Project BRIDGE (Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth); Bridge Open Access (Bridge OA)
systems.owner: Bridge Open Access, a project company with private investors in the majority and the Federal Government in the minority

note: The national fibre programme's project company is incorporated: the network is to reach all 774 local government areas, with no local government office said to be connected.
